For this node, the key falsification signals are backlog cancellations, hyperscaler capex pauses, falling transformer/switchgear/cooling lead times, margin compression from capacity additions, permitting restrictions on diesel/gas backup power, and evidence that AI rack-density improvements reduce facility-level power and cooling intensity.

node: Data-center power, cooling, grid interconnection, and energy supply
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe toward less obvious second-order beneficiaries tied to AI data-center power and thermal constraints. The highest-relevance additions are companies exposed to liquid cooling, rack-level power distribution, mechanical/electrical contracting, electrical-products distribution/logistics, and backup/onsite power. These are not buy/sell recommendations; they are research candidates for further evidence collection around backlog, data-center revenue mix, lead times, hyperscaler qualification, margin sustainability, and whether AI-driven demand is already priced in.
